outcome: Transfer to the intensive care unit
cohort: 80 triplet pregnancies delivered at a gestational age ≥28 weeks
finding: In a multicenter US cohort, attempted vaginal delivery of triplets was associated with higher risks of maternal transfusion and neonatal mechanical ventilation.
mod_finding: Attempted vaginal delivery of triplets is associated with higher risks of maternal transfusion and neonatal mechanical ventilation.
